title: Artfusion: New Fashion / New Art / New Photography 01

description.main: Inaugural issue of Artfusion, a bilingual Tokyo visual magazine edited by Shigeo Goto and Sawako Fukai (artbeat publishers) and distributed by Little More in March 2014. It pairs photographers with artists, dancers and designers: Chikashi Suzuki with Daito Manabe, Kishin Shinoyama with Jo Kanamori and Noism, Taisuke Koyama with Kohei Nawa, plus Viviane Sassen, Bettina Rheims, Daisuke Yokota, Ina Jang and others.
description.extended:
Artfusion 01 is the inaugural issue of a bilingual Tokyo visual magazine, launched in March 2014 under the editor and curator Shigeo Goto to pair photographers with artists, dancers and fashion designers.

Goto and Sawako Fukai edited it at artbeat publishers; Daishinsha published and Little More distributed. The project grew out of Goto's visual direction for the Isetan Shinjuku department store. Three commissioned pairings open the issue. Chikashi Suzuki photographs the actress Rila Fukushima from motion data scanned by Daito Manabe of Rhizomatiks. Kishin Shinoyama photographs Jo Kanamori and his company Noism on stage. Taisuke Koyama and the sculptor Kohei Nawa continue their 2011 series SANDWICH Textures. A New Japanese Photo section presents Toru Nagahama and Takashi Kawashima. Further portfolios come from Viviane Sassen, Mai-Thu Perret, Yuki Onodera with the designer Kunihiko Morinaga of Anrealage, Daisuke Yokota, Ina Jang, Taiyo Onorato and Nico Krebs, and Bettina Rheims. Nawa supplied the graphic textures and Manabe the digital typography. B4 variant format, 103 pages, Japanese and English text.

Goto (b. 1954) runs G/P Gallery in Ebisu and artbeat publishers, whose books by Yokota, Sassen and Onodera the library also holds. No second issue of Artfusion has been traced.
description.artist_bio: Shigeo Goto (b. 1954, Osaka) is an editor, curator and producer; founder of artbeat publishers and G/P Gallery, Ebisu, Tokyo; professor at Kyoto University of the Arts since 2003; overall visual director of the Isetan Shinjuku renewal from 2012.

notes: Shelf: Fashion. Issue 01 (March 2014); published by Daishinsha, edited by artbeat publishers (Shigeo Goto, Sawako Fukai), distributed by Little More under its ISBN. Cover title as printed: ARTFUSION: NEW FASHION/ NEW ART/ NEW PHOTO-GRAPHY 01, with the Japanese subtitle アートフュージョンと新しい写真. Publisher lists 103 pages; Perimeter and Amazon list 104. No second issue traced.
